title: WorryWords: Word-Anxiety Association via Best-Worst Scaling
description: Rate individual English words on the calmness-anxiety dimension using Best-Worst Scaling. Annotators see a 4-tuple of words and pick the one that most induces anxiety and the one that is most calming; real-valued anxiety-association scores are derived from best-minus-worst counts. This is the annotation design behind WorryWords, the first large-scale word-anxiety association lexicon (44,000+ words, Mohammad, EMNLP 2024), released with translations to 100+ languages.
